entities.name: Glycidyl ether epoxide opening
observations: Secondary piperazine nitrogen opens a glycidyl ether epoxide at the less substituted carbon, forming a beta-hydroxypropyl aryl ether and a tertiary piperazine.
Matched atom-mapped reaction record: ORD reaction ID ord-abead3cd6a9548fab8266ce8351ce8d8.

entities.name: Glycidyl ether substrate
observations: A glycidyl aryl ether provides the epoxide electrophile and becomes the beta-hydroxypropyl aryl ether substituent.

entities.name: Ethanol reaction medium
observations: Ethanol (CCO) is the strongest empirically matched reaction medium; no added catalyst or base was reported.

entities.name: Uncatalyzed epoxide opening
observations: Most defensible practical proposal is approximately equimolar piperazine nucleophile and glycidyl ether in absolute ethanol, with stirring and likely mild heating; specific temperature, time, yield, base, and catalyst remain unsubstantiated.
